## Overview

This model boasts an impressive set of capabilities, including text and vision processing, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, and extended thinking. With a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens, OpenAI o3 is well-suited for complex tasks that require in-depth reasoning and analysis.
